channel.title: Nature Communications
channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [6] Room-temperature continuous-wave lasing-like emission from solution-processed bulk monolayer MoS2 thin films
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Yu Huang, Xiangfeng Duan

Authors: Boxuan Zhou, Haoyang Li, Bangyao Hu, et al.

Score 6/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Important research on monolayer 2D material optical properties.

Tags: #2Dmaterials #MoS2 #optics

Abstract: Scaling up atomically thin light emitters remains challenging. Here, authors develop solution-processable bulk-monolayer MoS2 films that preserve monolayer optical properties and exhibit room-temperature lasing-like emission under continuous optical pumping at just a few nW.

item.title: [8] Signatures of a Kondo insulator in a multilayer moiré Superlattice
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Su-Fei Shi, Yong-Tao Cui

Authors: Qiran Wu, Jingyuan Cui, Ang-Kun Wu, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Important moiré superlattice experiment related to correlated electronic states.

Tags: #moire #Kondo #correlatedelectronsystem

Abstract: Kondo insulator phases are traditionally found in materials with f-electrons. Here, the authors present evidence towards the realization of a tunable Kondo insulator in a monolayer WS2/bilayer WSe2 moiré superlattice.
